about: Scripted calls for calibrating scam retrieval and testing the judgement. Invented; no real person or recording. 'expect' is the card a heads-up should name, or null when none should be named. The ordinary calls are chosen to be close to scams on the surface: a real grandson, a real bank, real Medicare mail.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: Grandpa? It's me, it's Tyler. I'm in trouble, I got arrested after a car accident and they won't let me go.

segments.speaker: account_holder
segments.text: Tyler? You sound different.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: My nose is broken from the airbag. Please don't tell Mom and Dad, they'll kill me. The lawyer says bail is six thousand and it has to be today.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: A man from the court will come to your house to pick up the cash. Just put it in an envelope.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: This is officer Daniels with the Social Security Administration. Your social security number has been suspended because it was found at a crime scene in Texas.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: To avoid a warrant, you need to confirm your number and we will move your savings to a protected government account.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: This is the Internal Revenue Service. Our records show you owe four thousand in back taxes and penalties.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: If you do not pay today, a local officer will arrest you. You can settle this now with Apple gift cards from any store.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: Hello, I am calling from Microsoft technical department. Your computer is sending us error messages, it has a dangerous virus.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: Please go to your computer and download the program I tell you so I can connect and fix it for you. There is a small fee of two hundred ninety nine dollars.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: This is the fraud department at your bank. We've seen two suspicious charges on your debit card in Florida.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: To stop them I'm sending you a code by text. Can you read me the six digits so I can verify you're the account holder?

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: Ma'am, I'm with your bank's security team. The technician who was just on your computer confirmed a foreign hacker has access to your savings.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: To protect your money you have to move it today into a safe account the Federal Reserve has set up for you. Don't tell the teller why, the hackers may have someone inside the branch.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: Hi, I'm calling from Medicare benefits. You qualify for a free back brace and knee brace at no cost to you.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: I just need to verify your Medicare number and your date of birth so we can ship them out.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: This is the electric company. Your account is past due and a crew is scheduled to disconnect your power within the next forty five minutes.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: To stop the disconnection you'll need to pay three hundred and eighty dollars right now through Cash App.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: Congratulations! You've won the second prize in the Publishers sweepstakes, two and a half million dollars and a new car.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: Before we can release your winnings you need to cover the tax and delivery fee of nine hundred dollars. Can you send that by wire today?

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: This is Lieutenant Price with the county sheriff's office. You failed to appear for jury duty last month and a bench warrant has been issued for your arrest.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: You can resolve this today by paying the fine of fifteen hundred dollars. Stay on the line while you get to a store.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: Morning! We were doing a job down the street and I noticed your roof has storm damage, a lot of loose shingles up there.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: I've got material left over so I can do it today for half price, but I need a cash deposit of two thousand to get started.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: Darling, I miss you so much. I can finally come and see you, I just have one problem at customs here on the oil platform.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: They are holding my luggage and my money until I pay a release fee. Could you send me two thousand through Western Union? I will pay you back when I land.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: Hi, this is Dr Patel's office calling to let you know your appointment on Thursday has moved to next Monday at ten thirty.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: Please call us back if that time doesn't work for you.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: Hi Dad, it's Sarah. The branch called me to say your new debit card is ready to pick up.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: I'll take you on Saturday morning and we can get lunch after.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: Hey Grandpa, it's Tyler. My car's in the shop again, any chance you could pick me up from practice on Friday?

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: Mom said it's fine. I'll pay you back for the gas, I promise.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: This is Walgreens pharmacy with a reminder that your prescription is ready for pickup.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: Your insurance covered it, so there's no copay this time.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: Mom, open enrolment for Medicare starts next week. Don't sign anything anyone sends you.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: I'll come over Sunday and we'll look at the plans together on the Medicare website.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: You'll never guess, I won the big prize at church bingo last night, two hundred dollars!

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: I'm taking us both out for pie on Tuesday to celebrate.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: Hi, this is a courtesy call from City Water. We'll be doing maintenance on your street Wednesday and water will be off from nine to noon.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: No action is needed on your part.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: Hi Margaret, it's Linda from St Mark's. Just reminding you the bake sale for the roof fund is on Saturday.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: If you're still making your lemon bars, bring them by the hall any time after eight.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: Grandma, guess what, I passed my driving test! First try.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: Mom's letting me borrow the car so I can come visit you this weekend.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: Hi, it's Mike from Reliable Plumbing, confirming we'll be out tomorrow between one and three to look at the water heater, like you booked last week.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: We'll give you a written quote before we do any work.
